name: outrunner 8318 21p - SHAPE, not measured
note: Not a measurement. A SHAPE for the identifier to recover: numbers of the order a 83 mm, 18 mm stack, high pole count outrunner has, so autodetect is exercised against more than one machine and a step that only works on the placeholder is caught. `tools/commission.py` and `observer.autodetect` write a real motor over the record; a profile is how one is kept and put back. `drive` keys are coaxial.drive.PARAMS names in SI, `model` keys coaxial.drive.MODEL_PARAMS names.
